exposure: Care model (House for Pregnant Women vs traditional hospital maternity ward)
cohort: 312 high-risk pregnant women with gestational ages ranging from 22 to 36 weeks and 6 days in Belo Horizonte, Brazil
finding: The House for Pregnant Women care model, utilizing midwives, was associated with less interventionist care (fewer antenatal exams, lower frequencies of blood pressure diagnoses, fewer C-sections, episiotomies, and use of analgesia) compared to a traditional hospital maternity ward, with no differences in newborn characteristics.
